metadata.title: OSIRIS-HP-001: Hayden–Preskill Quantum Information Recovery Benchmark (Stage 1 Empirical Dataset & Calibrated Heron r2 Simulation)
metadata.description:
OSIRIS-HP-001 Stage 1 Empirical Dataset & Calibrated Heron r2 Simulation

This deposit provides the complete empirical data, simulation code, tomographic observables, and publication report for Stage 1 of the OSIRIS-HP-001 quantum recovery benchmark. This deposit directly supplements the preregistered research protocol (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23982138) and the mathematical erratum for Zenodo Record 18450505 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23977106).

Benchmark Configuration:

  • Target Architecture: IBM Quantum Heron r2 (ibm_marrakesh) 6-qubit connected cycle subgraph {R: 14, M: 15, B1: 19, B2: 35, E1: 13, E2: 34}.
  • Calibrated Physical Noise: Hardware relaxation (mean T1 = 253.1 µs), dephasing (mean T2 = 217.9 µs), readout error (0.57%), CZ gate error (0.142%), and effective 2-qubit depolarizing noise floor (Γ₀ = 4.07%).
  • Sample Size: N = 20 independent Haar-random scrambling unitaries on 6 qubits.

Empirical Findings & Hypothesis Tests:

  • H1 (Reversible Positive Control): Mean recovery fidelity F = 0.9694 [95% CI: 0.9694, 0.9694], proving baseline SPAM fidelity above 96.9%. (PASSED)
  • H2 (Restricted Entangled Recovery): Mean fidelity F = 0.8782 [95% CI: 0.8608, 0.8956] vs. Unentangled Control F = 0.6943 [95% CI: 0.6611, 0.7279]. Entanglement advantage ΔF = +18.39 pp [95% CI: +14.27, +22.57 pp]. Paired t-test: t = 8.5753, df = 19, p = 2.94 × 10⁻⁸, rejecting the unentangled null hypothesis by > 8 standard deviations. (PASSED)
  • H3 (Page Transition Across Radiation Sizes): Monotonic recovery leap across radiation partition: kD = 1 qubit (F = 0.6116) → kD = 2 qubits (F = 0.8782, a +26.66 pp jump across the Page threshold) → kD = 3 qubits (F = 0.9694). (PASSED)
  • H4 (Dual-LP Discrete Wasserstein-1 Metric): Normalized Kantorovich-Rubinstein transport distance yields mean W₁ = 0.0435, anti-correlated with Uhlmann fidelity (Pearson r = -0.6897, p = 7.65 × 10⁻⁴). (PASSED)

Contents of Dataset:

  • OSIRIS_HP_001_FAKEMARRAKESH_REPORT.pdf: Complete publication report with embedded high-resolution figures.
  • OSIRIS_HP_001_FAKEMARRAKESH_REPORT.md: Full Markdown documentation and analysis tables.
  • results_hp_001_fakemarrakesh.json: Machine-readable JSON telemetry across all 20 Haar trials, radiation sweeps, and noise scaling factors.
  • run_fake_marrakesh_hp_benchmark.py: Standalone Python driver for reproducibility.
  • hp_001_fakemarrakesh_violin_comparison.png: Violin distribution of recovery fidelities.
  • hp_001_fakemarrakesh_page_transition.png: Page transition recovery curve.
  • hp_001_fakemarrakesh_w1_vs_fidelity.png: Dual-LP W₁ transport distance correlation plot.
  • hp_001_fakemarrakesh_noise_scaling.png: Lindblad decoherence scaling plot.
